title: CrawlRecordV1
description: One fetched page, written by the Go crawler into segment files (pages.jsonl.zst) and read by the Rust indexer. Both sides validate.

vertical.description: Vertical pack id this page was crawled under

canonical_url.description: Canonicalized URL used as the document identity everywhere downstream

status_code.description: HTTP status of the final response

content_type.description: Response Content-Type without parameters, e.g. text/html

depth.description: Link depth from the nearest seed (seeds are depth 0)

html.description: Raw response body (UTF-8 HTML). Size-capped by the crawler before writing.

links.description: Outbound links discovered on the page, canonicalized

simhash64.description: 64-bit SimHash of the extracted text, hex-encoded (16 chars). Absent until P2.

last_modified.description: Last-Modified response header if present, RFC 1123 as sent
